problem.question: John watches a TV show and they announce they are going to do 1 more season.  Each season is 22 episodes except for the last season which is 4 episodes longer.  There were 9 seasons before the announcement.  If each episode is .5 hours how long will it take to watch them all after the last season finishes?
problem.answer:
There are currently 9*22=<<9*22=198>>198 episodes out
The new season will have 22+4=<<22+4=26>>26 episodes
So the total number of episodes is 198+26=<<198+26=224>>224 episodes
So it will take 224*.5=<<224*.5=112>>112 hours to watch them all
#### 112
